settings.question: How much better is Pro pricing?
settings.answer: Pro prices are lower than Member prices on eligible products. The difference varies by style, color, size and quantity, and products already on sale keep whichever price is lower, so Pro isn’t a flat percentage off. Compare Member and Pro prices on real styles above.

settings.question: How does Threads Cash work?
settings.answer: Pro members earn [cash_rate] back in Threads Cash on eligible purchases. Eligible Threads Cash becomes available in your account on the first of each month, and you can use it toward future eligible orders.

settings.question: How do the monthly shipping savings work?
settings.answer: Once a month, take up to [ship_max] off shipping on a qualifying order with at least [ship_min] in merchandise. That’s up to [ship_year] a year. The credit can’t exceed the actual shipping charge, unused credits don’t roll over, and orders of [free_ship] or more already ship free.

settings.question: Can Pro benefits be combined with sales and bulk discounts?
settings.answer: Pending policy: how Pro pricing works with Member Deals and bulk pricing. Products already on sale keep whichever price is lower.

settings.question: How much do I need to buy for Pro to pay for itself?
settings.answer: About [cash_cover_spend] a year in eligible purchases earns [cash_cover_cash] in Threads Cash, enough to cover the [fee] membership through rewards alone. Monthly shipping savings add up to [ship_year] a year, and everything you save through exclusive Pro pricing is on top.

settings.question: What if my rewards don’t cover the membership?
settings.answer: Pending policy: the Pro Promise refunds the difference when your Threads Cash and shipping savings don’t cover the [fee] fee, at each membership anniversary. Pro pricing savings don’t reduce the refund. Rewards still pending at the anniversary, settlement timing and the refund method are being finalized.

settings.question: When do my Pro benefits begin?
settings.answer: Pending policy: Pro pricing starts once your membership payment is processed. Confirm timing and how a first order placed with the membership is priced.

settings.question: How does renewal work?
settings.answer: Pending policy: Pro is billed once for 12 months. We’ll remind you before it’s due to renew. Automatic renewal is not yet decided.

settings.question: Do I need to own a registered business?
settings.answer: Pending policy: confirm whether Pro is open to every Ashley’s Threads account.

settings.question: Does Threads Cash expire?
settings.answer: Pending policy: expiry, return adjustments, redemption limits and excluded products.
